verdict.rationale: Oneleet's frameworks page names SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR and others as supported on its "all-in-one platform" (oneleet-docs-29). The docs show multiple frameworks sharing controls in one workspace, with shared controls kept when a framework is removed (oneleet-docs-15). The vendor also claims one price with no per-framework fees (oneleet-docs-14). missing for 10: framework-specific documentation for HIPAA/GDPR/PCI DSS (control libraries, policy templates, audit workflows), and independent or hands-on corroboration that these frameworks work as deeply as SOC 2.
